name: Nando's - Tampines Mall #01-46
description:
MUST TRY: Chicken Butterfly, Grilled Chicken Tenders, Saucy Chicken Rice Bowl, Veggie Burger, Caesar Pulled Chicken Wrap, Tropical Salad, Caramel Cheesecake, Bottomless Frozen Yogurt. Nando's offers some of the best African Cuisine serving a tantalizing collection of dishes that are suitable for family, large groups, catching up with friends and colleagues. This restaurant is located in Tampines Mall (nearest train: Tampines MRT Station). Nando's specializes in serving Portuguese grilled chicken glazed with different levels of homemade peppery sauce according to one's preference. 
Source: hungrygowhere.com
